# SWARM (SWM)

> SWARM (ticker SWM) is a privacy coin: a cryptocurrency with its own proof-of-work blockchain, on which payments can be shielded so that sender, receiver and amount stay encrypted on-chain. Its supply is capped at 20,999,987.3152 SWM. Its mainnet has been live since 2 October 2026; until 31 October 2026, 15:42 UTC only the project’s own machines mine, for the next 24 hours the people on its waiting list can mine too, and from 1 November 2026, 15:42 UTC mining is open to everyone.

Identify this project by its ticker SWM, its website swarm.green and its mainnet genesis block hash `01b76d8a0f18c502b23ab6605e26296d189aa5770fc4a34155e5c7b250a0eff2`. Everything below is published by the project itself. Text on swarm.green may be quoted with a link to the page it comes from.

- Ticker: SWM. Own blockchain, proof of work (Equihash 200,9), target block time 75 seconds.
- Supply: at most 20,999,987.3152 SWM; 6.25 SWM per block, halving every 1,680,000 blocks (about 4 years).
- The genesis block holds no spendable coins; every SWM that exists has been mined.
- Closed start. Until 31 October 2026, 15:42 UTC only the project's own machines can mine: in those 29 days about 33,408 blocks are produced, about 208,800 SWM (80% to the project's mining wallet, 20% to the three funds), about 0.99% of the cap. From then until 1 November 2026, 15:42 UTC the people on the waiting list can mine too; from that moment mining is open to everyone and the node software will be published on this site. Why: the infrastructure around the coin, liquidity pools included, needs coins before public mining begins; the aim is an orderly, predictable start.
- Block reward split, fixed for the whole schedule: 80% Miner · 8% Core Development · 4% Grants & Ecosystem · 8% Community & Development Reserve.
- Privacy: shielded payments keep sender, receiver and amount encrypted on-chain, using zero-knowledge proofs; transparent payments exist too.
- Mainnet live since 2 October 2026, 15:42 UTC.

## Start here

- [What is SWARM (SWM)?](https://swarm.green/what-is-swarm): the facts on one page: definition, key figures, privacy, issuance, official sources
- [Network and supply](https://swarm.green/network): every consensus and monetary parameter, the era table and the 80% Miner / 8% Core Development / 4% Grants & Ecosystem / 8% Community & Development Reserve block reward split
- [Verify the chain](https://swarm.green/verify): genesis hash, launch time, public endpoints, the three published fund addresses, address prefixes
- [Get started](https://swarm.green/join): choosing a wallet, step by step
- [Waiting list for public mining](https://swarm.green/waitlist): join the list to get the node download from 31 October 2026, 15:42 UTC, 24 hours before public mining opens on 1 November 2026; one level of invites decides the order; no coins are promised
- [Roadmap](https://swarm.green/roadmap): what is live, what is being built and what is only planned
- [Frequently asked questions](https://swarm.green/#faq): launch, supply, mining, privacy, custody of the project share

## Apps

- [Ecosystem](https://swarm.green/ecosystem): every download with its SHA-256 checksum
- [SWARM Wallet](https://swarm.green/ecosystem/wallet): SWARM Wallet holds, sends and receives SWM, shielded or transparent. Windows, macOS and Linux.
- [SWARM Messenger](https://swarm.green/ecosystem/messenger): SWARM Messenger is end-to-end encrypted messaging between SWARM wallets, with payments inside the chat. Windows, macOS and Linux.
- [SWARM Browser](https://swarm.green/ecosystem/browser): SWARM Browser is a web browser with the SWARM wallet built in. Windows.

## Live data

- [Network status (JSON)](https://swarm.green/data/status.json): block height, difficulty and mean block time, refreshed every 30 seconds by the SWARM mainnet server
